[[Grenth's Grasp (scythe)|Grenth's Grasp]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Acolyte of Grenth]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Arkjok Ward]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Razorclaw Scythe]].
